campaign.title: Rename CASE006_LOW preserving semantic identity and call bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION CASE006_LOW(X)
  CASE006_LOW = 0
  IF (X < 9) THEN
    CASE006_LOW = 1
  END IF
  CASE006_LOW = CASE006_LOW
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE006_HIGH(X)
  CASE006_HIGH = 0
  IF (X >= 11) THEN
    CASE006_HIGH = 1
  END IF
  CASE006_HIGH = CASE006_HIGH
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION CASE006_EITHER(X)
  CASE006_EITHER = 0
  IF (CASE006_LOW(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE006_EITHER = 1
  END IF
  IF (CASE006_HIGH(X) >= 1) THEN
    CASE006_EITHER = 1
  END IF
  CASE006_EITHER = CASE006_EITHER
END FUNCTION
